scope: Provider-free conditional observed association from the immutable DEV020 compact extrema journal.
contract: A row qualifies at a threshold when retained lowest observed MC is at least that percentage below qualified opening and that low precedes the selected observed peak. Subsequent peak crossings are observed associations, not first-crossing signals, executable fills, or recovery-time evidence.
death_threshold_assessment: Recovery declines gradually through -40% (74.4%), then drops 12.2 percentage points at -50%, 22.7 at -60%, and 15.3 at -70%. The retained association is consistent with a deterioration zone around -50% to -60%, not a precise statistically identified permanent-death threshold. Nested thresholds and sparse windows preclude independent-bin significance claims.
entry_potential: -10/-20/-30/-40/-50% entries have 471/420/330/246/156 observed threshold reaches. Retained extrema allow maximum-upside bounds only; entry fill, deeper adverse movement after entry, stops, exits, and holding duration are EXECUTION_ORDER_UNPROVEN.
stop_tradeoff: -30/-40/-50/-60/-70% stop reaches have 330/246/156/86/62 tokens; their above-opening associations are 79.7%/74.4%/62.2%/39.5%/24.2%. These counts identify potential winners a stop could exclude, but cannot estimate realized loss avoidance because entry-before-stop and target/stop order are absent.
combinations: No entry/stop combination is ranked as profitable. -20/-50 and -30/-50 deserve only a future ordered-path experiment because they balance sample size with a materially lower conditional recovery group; -40/-70 is not supported by its low 24.2% conditional recovery. These are research priorities, not recommendations.
recovery_time: Median time-to-recovery-above-opening is unavailable: retained recovery_time_seconds measures recovery above a preceding high only, not first recovery above opening.
limitations: nested thresholds are not independent samples
storage: Compact JSON only; no raw provider response, new journal, or 500 MB growth path.
